answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions 100 entry slots; the top bids win. The auction bends like a willow with demand, yet every bid is a signal no free identity can fake, and it hears any whisper of collusion. Winners lock their bid for 20 epochs, lost on cheating, so a farmer buying 100 fake seats pays 100 times the clearing price of 50 POA each, 5,000 POA, while an honest agent pays once and drinks the nectar undiluted. Losing bids return.
